walkthrough: Goal: go through every kind of exercise one by one to try it, and practise one kind on purpose (专项训练), without it counting as a session of the course.

Entry: in the gallery the Today card's options button (Practice options). On a screen wide enough its first page has two columns: Practice at the left, the practice packs and colour copies at the right (under it on a narrow screen). Practice holds each ready stage as a row, its name at the left (Stage 1 · Lines and colours, Stage 2 · Single shapes, Stage 3 · Points) and Start a session at the right; the row tapped starts that stage's next session at once, as the stages did before (the next stage early, an earlier one to revisit). Under each row the stage's kinds as small framed tiles, each a little line drawing of the kind with its name under it: Line, Combined lines, Colour; Shape, Colour combination, Value scale, Box, Free boxes, Ellipse; Point, Proportion, Angle, Centre, Halves, Thirds, Next face, Mirror. Fresh, every tile is in pencil, picture and name: nothing compared yet. No ticks, no counts, no other words.
Shape without any pack picture: tapped, nothing starts; a line under the stage's tiles says that shapes copy a practice pack's pictures and to import one under Practice packs.

Line: a drill of six single lines on a sheet of its own. Its How shows first, as it will every time a drill opens; Got it. The bar reads Line 1 of 6 · How · Compare · Next. I copy the line with Draw and tap Compare: the original lies over it in red, In place or Aligned, as in a session. I go back to the gallery with one line done: the Today card is as it was (Stage 1, its road with nothing done, Start practice). In the options Line is now drawn in ink, its name in ink, and its tile is ringed: a drill left unfinished, as Next is ringed on the road.

Centre: a drill of three points in space by the centre trick. Its How shows first; Got it. The bar: Centre 1 of 3. I cross the face's diagonals with Sketch but mark the middle of the drawing with Draw; Compare: the exact centre red where the diagonals cross, nearer the far edge, my dot ringed blue; the left box shows the construction. A blue cross on the red, Compare: ringed on it. Undo takes the cross away, Redo brings it back. Next: Centre 2 of 3; I leave for the gallery. The options: Centre in ink and ringed, Line in ink and ringed, every other tile in pencil.

Centre tapped again continues the drill where I left it, Centre 2 of 3, its How first again. I mark it, compare, Next, mark the third, compare, Finish: the card says Centre drill done and counts Centres: 3 of 3 compared; no road and no session dot, for a drill is no session; the bar Centre drill done · One more. One more: a new Centre drill on the same sheet, laid from the row under the first (S121c), its How first, Centre 1 of 3 (in the harness every sheet takes the same seed, so its box is the first drill's again; on the tablet another).

Gallery: the Today card unchanged, nothing done on the road, Start practice. The options: Line and Centre in ink, both ringed (the new centre drill is open). The practice book: 0 sessions and the time the drills took; the road nothing done; today washed by that time. Today tapped: its card lists the drills' sheets small, Line drill 1 and the one sheet of Centre drill 1 · Centre drill 2 (S121c), a tap opening one.
Undo: a drill's marks are strokes on its sheet, undone and redone within the exercise shown as in a session; a drill continued from its tile opens as I left it, its record and sheet kept.

This copy runs as on a Chinese tablet: 练习, 第 1 阶段 · 线条与色彩 with 开始一次练习, the tiles 线条, 组合线条, 单色 and on; the bar 中心 1/3 · 怎么练 · 叠图对比 · 下一个; the summary 中心专项练习完成; the book's 线条专项 1, 中心专项 1, 中心专项 2. The steps and the canvas's hashes are the English run's (s91-drills).
Not here: a drill of each other kind (their exercises are the stages' own, walked by s75 to s90); shapes from a pack (s80's); the author's own hand on the tablet.
